output.content:
The comparison is saved in the workspace as a completed comparison of viable cell density, matched at exact elapsed sample times (tolerance 0 h) — 23 matched pairs per batch, spanning 0.0 to 328.5 elapsed hours, with no unmatched sample times on either side. Differences are defined as CHO-010-R02 minus CHO-010-R01, as requested.

**Numerical result (unit: cells/mL):**
- **Batches compared:** CHO-010-R01 and CHO-010-R02 (both from the Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs delivery)
- **Mean signed difference:** −167,811.43 cells/mL — R02 runs lower than R01 on average
- **Largest absolute difference:** 1,466,667 cells/mL at **233.5 elapsed hours** (R01 = 14,866,667 cells/mL vs R02 = 13,400,000 cells/mL; signed difference −1,466,667 cells/mL)

Supporting figures from the same saved result: median difference −100,000 cells/mL, standard deviation 467,183.82 cells/mL, and 30.4% of the 23 time points favor R02 (largest positive difference +733,333 cells/mL at 217.5 h). The summary is descriptive only — successive samples of one run are not independent, so no significance test is reported — and product, process version, equipment, scale and process stage were not recorded for these batches, so comparability context is not established.

**Provisional status:** all values used come from deliveries still in review. The Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs delivery (source of both CHO-010 batches) is provisional — its 46 values here were read from the delivery files and not yet reviewed, with 54 open missing-field checks, so verify the delivery before relying on these numbers. The Northfield Biologics October and November deliveries are also still in review, though they were not used in this comparison.
